summary: Source-reviewed re-review resolved the framework-only blocker: Table 2 MIC rows, DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows, and mechanism claims were reopened from local XML/PDF/SI/package/database evidence. The paper is accepted with cautions because noncanonical Trp analogue database sequences remain X-coded rather than normalized.

materials_exhausted.notes: OA package contained the SI PDF; no office/spreadsheet supplement was present. The SI PDF and extracted text were checked for sequence/mass/mechanism context.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Structural material status remains material_extracted_with_gaps, but XML/PDF/OA package/SI PDF text and database snapshots were sufficient for worker-4/6 source adjudication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 65 linked DBAASP rows were reviewed. Standard nisin/Nisin I1W rows are source_verified; 36 noncanonical analogue assay/experiment rows are sequence_modified_not_normalized with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity output was rebuilt from primary Table 2 as 30 MIC rows with entity, target, raw value, unit, method, and locator; no toxicity table is reported in local material.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to maturation, lipid II binding, and bactericidal time-kill evidence with direct assay locators and stated limitations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_adjudication: The stale framework-test ticket is resolved; no blocking or major QC failure remains after source review.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 2/Table 1/SI evidence supports 5OHTrp, 5BrTrp, and 6BrTrp nisin(I1W) variants, while DBAASP sequence rows encode the modified residue as X and the peptide name as I1X. The final audit preserves this as sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than converting it to a canonical sequence.

The packet material layer remains material_extracted_with_gaps because no structured supplementary table parser output exists, but the OA package SI PDF was reopened and did not create an unresolved worker-4/6 publication blocker.
